meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, LSP, and language-native tooling. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码库九大维度,输出带优先级的技术债报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想动手重构前先摸清代码库里哪些地方最该修。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code on 9 dimensions and get a prioritized tech-debt report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what to fix before refactoring.

howto.what: 它会扫描你的代码仓库,从架构、类型、测试、安全等 9 个维度查技术债,每条问题都标注具体文件名与行号、严重程度和修复工时,最后生成一份 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md 报告。
howto.when: 当你提到 “tech debt”、“debt audit” 等关键词,或要求对代码库做健康检查、架构审查时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个仓库的技术债,重点看安全维度
先跑一次代码库健康检查,列出 30 分钟内能修的问题
say.note: 报告里会有 Quick Wins 清单

say.text: 重构前做一次架构审查,看看有没有循环依赖
say.note: 按影响与工时排序给出 Top 5 优先级

howto.what_en: It scans your repo for technical debt across 9 dimensions, cites every finding with file:line:col, tags severity and effort hours, and writes a prioritized TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "tech debt", "debt audit" and similar keywords, or ask for a codebase health check or architecture review.

say_en.text: Audit this repo for tech debt, focusing on security
Run a codebase health check and list 30-minute fixes
say_en.note: Report includes a Quick Wins checklist

say_en.text: Review the architecture before refactoring for import cycles
